template:
# Create the namespace and make it the default for this context
kubectl create {{0}} notes
kubectl config set-context --current --{{1}}=notes

# Store the database password as a Secret
kubectl create secret {{2}} notes-db --from-literal=POSTGRES_PASSWORD=dev-only-change-me

# Read it back (and see that it isn't encrypted)
kubectl get secret notes-db -o jsonpath='{.data.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}' | base64 {{3}}

# Pick up changed environment variables in running Pods
kubectl rollout {{4}} deployment/notes-api
